steps.title: The axes
steps.say: Price is on the vertical axis and quantity on the horizontal axis.

steps.title: Demand curve
steps.say: Demand slopes down: the higher the price, the less people want to buy.

steps.title: Supply curve
steps.say: Supply slopes up: the higher the price, the more sellers want to sell.

steps.title: Starting equilibrium
steps.say: Where the curves cross, the market settles at price 5 and quantity 5.

steps.title: Demand rises
steps.say: Now buyers want more at every price, so the demand curve moves to the right. The equilibrium slides up along the supply curve: the price rises and so does the quantity.

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.say: Drag the curves to see how the price changes. When demand rises, the price goes up.
